This textual variant reflects different vocalization traditions for the same consonantal text, a common phenomenon in the Masoretic tradition. - Keep gloss_readable at 40-120 words.

- Do NOT transliterate Hebrew/Greek terms — keep them in their original script where appropriate.
- Output valid JSON only.
